name: Easy Integration With Google Calendar
author: Pluginscafe

sections.description:
Easily integrate Google Calendar with your WordPress site in just minutes using your forms. Enjoy stunning calendar displays that are fully mobile responsive.

How do you configure the Google Calendar app to work with this plugin?

To use the easy integration with google calender, a Google oAuth credential is required. Add credential in settings fields and save it.

Youtube Video

Get Google oAuth credential
sections.installation:
1. Upload and unzip easy-integration-with-google-calendar.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
